title: Kuala Lumpur to Penang: Malaysia West Coast Express
subtitle: A 3-day family EV road trip through Ipoh to the Pearl of the Orient

route.kidActivities: Batu Caves, Lost World of Tambun water park
Penang Hill railway, Batu Ferringhi Beach, ESCAPE Penang
Pinang Peranakan Mansion, street art walk, Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion

bestFor: Foodie families wanting Malaysia's best street food and cultural heritage
